title.zh: RSA 公钥加密 · 乘起来容易，拆开来难
title.en: RSA Public-Key Encryption · Easy to Multiply, Hard to Split

desc.zh: 把两个大质数相乘只要一步，从乘积倒推两个质数却要天文数字的步数——这种不对称，让“公开的锁、私藏的钥匙”成为可能。
desc.en: Multiplying two big primes takes one step; recovering them from the product takes an astronomical number — and that asymmetry makes a public lock and a private key possible.
